milestone: Shared KV450 prefixes, physically checked append offsets, bounded 512-descriptor native owner
changes: Tail contexts share one fixed 450-token i16 buffer; creating a continuation allocates no device buffer and copies no earlier prefix
c71_signed_append_at requires the caller's expected physical initialized offset before D2D, so stale/forked continuations fail before copying
Historical Tail metadata keeps its logical old/prefix/context, while QK/PV read only the requested causal prefix even after later tokens are initialized
Sharing/releasing an Arc<Buffer> checks Runtime identity; physical release occurs only with the last descriptor
Native owner has 512 fixed descriptors, counted in host_owner_bytes, rather than 64; descriptor exhaustion remains terminal

coverage.prefixes: One synthetic canonical K source across all three contexts, no continuation allocation/D2D, historical QK after all 450 tokens initialized, exact outputs versus integer expectations, and release only at the last shared view.
coverage.negative: A second continuation of the same completed 150-token predecessor is rejected after the first appends, with no D2D increase; common runtime stops. Not a substitute for accepted-registry authorization.
coverage.descriptors: 512 simultaneous one-byte logical allocations, capacities 512*256=131072 bytes, release and reuse; the 513th allocation stops the owner without growing its 262144-byte arena.
coverage.regressions: All resident operator/gather tests, both attention families at O0/O150/O300, RMS and EXP30; shared and standalone byte/signed native range transcript/original-MAC parity and failures. Deferred host driver only.

clippy.command: cargo clippy --offline --locked -j 1 -p volta-pcs --features c71-seed6-reference --lib --tests -- -D clippy::correctness -D clippy::suspicious

cuda.kernels: No kernel arithmetic changes; shared-tail span and append guards are in the host runtime. Older libraries without the checked append symbol fail during API loading.

memory_and_traffic.tail_capacity: 450*columns*2 bytes per original KV source, 256-byte aligned, charged inside the existing arena. Do not add KV to arena reservation a second time or omit its used capacity.
memory_and_traffic.append_traffic: Only new rows, two bytes per cell, one fence before initialized-prefix advancement.
memory_and_traffic.scope: The KV prefix test covers one canonical K source, not all model KV simultaneously. Complete CPU/PCS/Seed6/HBM capacities and runtime overhead remain to be reconciled.
